name: Tobacco, Alcohol, Prescription medication, and other Substance use Tool
developer: National Institute on Drug Abuse Clinical Trials Network
arabic_status: Rawafid independent operational Arabic rendering; no Arabic psychometric validation is claimed in this release

part1.routing_rule: Any response other than never routes that domain to TAPS-2

alcohol_threshold.original_form: 5+ drinks for men / 4+ drinks for women in one day
alcohol_threshold.rawafid_implementation: examiner explicitly records which 4+ or 5+ threshold was used; threshold must remain consistent for longitudinal comparisons

part2.reference_period: past 3 months unless the item is explicitly framed as habitual/concern
part2.substance_specific_scoring: Each yes response contributes one point within that substance category only

interpretation.score_ge_1: Validation literature found high sensitivity for problem use for most substances at >=1; performance varies by substance
interpretation.score_ge_2: For several substance classes, >=2 improves specificity for substance use disorder but reduces sensitivity

safety: TAPS does not assess acute intoxication severity
TAPS does not assess withdrawal severity
TAPS does not by itself assess overdose risk
Do not recommend abrupt discontinuation of prescribed sedatives, opioids, or other medications from a TAPS score alone
